999008199.text:
わたくしを呼び出そうと思うなんて、
さすがはクリセルダと言うべきかしら

localizations.en: To think you would summon me here... I suppose that's just like you, Criselda.

999008199.text:
あら。もう党首ではない私が一国の王を呼び出すなんて
不敬だったかしら？

localizations.en: Oh my. Was it improper for someone who's no longer a party leader to summon the ruler of a nation?

999008199.text:
いいえ。あなたにはたくさんの恩がありますもの。
それくらいでとやかくは言いませんわ

localizations.en: Not at all. I owe you a great deal. I won't make a fuss over something like that.

999008199.text:
ですが、わたくしの邪魔をすると言うのであれば
話は別です。何を企んでおりますの？

localizations.en: However, if you intend to interfere with my plans, that's another matter entirely. What are you scheming?

999008199.text: ……これを見なさい

石……ですの？
なにやら力が込められているようですが

localizations.en: A stone? It seems to have some sort of power contained within it.

999008199.text:
この会場の観客たちの感情の昂り……
その力を大量に封じ込めたものよ

localizations.en: The heightened emotions of the audience at this venue... I've sealed a tremendous amount of that power inside.

999008199.text: なんのためにそのようなものを？

localizations.en: And what purpose does such a thing serve?

999008199.text: 水着の美少女たちをもっと堪能するためよ

localizations.en: To better appreciate beautiful girls in swimsuits, of course.

999008199.text:
この浜辺をもっと盛り上げることができれば、
色んな水着の少女たちが来ると思わない？

localizations.en: If we could make this beach more exciting permanently, don't you think all sorts of girls in swimsuits would come here?

999008199.text:
それは、そうでしょうが。
何が言いたいんですの？

localizations.en: Well, yes, I suppose they would. What exactly are you getting at?

999008199.text:
そのためには、この浜辺が恒久的に
安全である必要があるわ

localizations.en: For that to happen, this beach needs to be permanently safe.

999008199.text: ……！　まさか、この浜辺は安全ではないと？

localizations.en: ...! You mean to say this beach isn't safe?

999008199.text:
今は一時的に安全でしょうね。
あれだけ魔物を倒せば

localizations.en: It's temporarily safe now. After defeating that many monsters, it would be.

999008199.text:
けれど、まだ潜んでいる魔物は必ずいる。
放置していればまた数を増やすでしょう

localizations.en: But there are certainly monsters still lurking about. Left alone, they'll multiply again.

999008199.text:
そして人々の賑わい……感情の揺れ動きに誘われ
また姿を現す

localizations.en: And drawn by the crowds... by the emotional energy, they'll show themselves again.

999008199.text:
浜辺には悪評が立ち、人が離れ……
討伐することで人が戻り、また魔物が現れる

localizations.en: The beach will get a bad reputation and people will leave... then more people will come back after the monsters are defeated, only for monsters to appear again.

999008199.text:
この浜辺はこれを繰り返しているのよ。
いつまでたっても安心して水着の美少女を堪能できない

localizations.en: This beach has been repeating this cycle. We'll never be able to peacefully appreciate beautiful girls in swimsuits at this rate.

999008199.text:
……分かりましたわ。
あなたのやろうとしていることが

localizations.en: ...I understand what you're trying to do now.

999008199.text:
ララ……協力してくれる？ 今、このひとときの
私の渇望は、女の子の水着なのよ

localizations.en: Will you help me, Lara? Right now, at this very moment, my burning desire is for girls in swimsuits.

999008199.text:
……はあ。仕方ありませんわね。
皆を危険にさらすわけにはいきませんわ

localizations.en: ...Sigh. I suppose I have no choice. I can't let everyone be put in danger.

999008199.text: わたくしも一枚噛むといたしましょう

localizations.en: Very well, I'll lend you my assistance.
